title: The Quiet Visitor
author: E. M. Dunmore
blurb: Felix Vane, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
